_comment: Exploratory W0 registration (PLAN 8.1 amendment R-20261017-014), frozen BEFORE any exploratory run. Human-readable twin: PREREG_explore_w0.md. Do not edit after the spec is approved.
plan_amendment_quote: The original and rev-1 gates failed and remain failed. After observing these failures, we authorize a bounded exploratory W0 study under unchanged, uncalibrated parameters. This waives §8.1's threshold-superiority prerequisite; it does not establish simulator validity. Static-ramp and preprovisioned fixed_best remain primary deployable comparators; oracle replay is a clairvoyant reference. No parameter, workload, or acceptance-rule changes will follow these results. Confirmatory claims require calibration and separately frozen evaluation.
status: exploratory; no confirmatory claim; gates remain FAILED

training.hyperparameters: train_eval.py defaults (batch 16, replay every step), agent defaults; unchanged

checkpoint_rule: last: the agent state at the end of training (step = train_steps), greedy (epsilon 0); no checkpoint or seed selection on any evaluation or validation episode

hpa.selection: mean return over selection_seeds, default config, 5000-step episodes; ties -> smallest target; must be interior
hpa.disclosed_asymmetry: K8sHPA may change many pods per step (absolute replica target); the agents and all other comparators are limited to +-1 pod per step. Agents are not changed.
hpa.metric: cpu_util_pct: busy-fraction proxy: served / effective capacity, saturating at 100 % before noise/offset. Request = limit is an ASSUMPTION; the proxy cannot distinguish moderate from extreme overload (at target 40 % a saturated reading requests about 2.5x the ready replicas, whatever the real backlog). Requests do NOT shrink during rebalancing or with theta < 1: the proxy's denominator is the reduced effective capacity, so it reads higher than usage over a fixed request would. A real request < limit needs a calibrated CPU usage/request model (future work)

analysis.method_return: agent return per evaluation episode = mean over the 3 training seeds (per-seed results reported too)
analysis.contrasts: paired differences (method - static_ramp_best) and (method - fixed_best) per evaluation episode, for every agent and for threshold and k8s_hpa
analysis.primary: default config; every other config descriptive only
analysis.decision_rule: none: exploratory; CIs are reported, nothing is accepted or rejected

bootstrap.scope: conditional on the three trained models per agent (episode resampling); omits training-seed population uncertainty

never_evaluated_here: final test 20000-20999 (reserved for the calibrated study)

labels.oracle: clairvoyant +-1 reference; not an upper bound on multi-pod HPA performance
